CS101 Synthetic Tutorial 02

Q1. What is the difference between iterating over a list and changing the list while iterating?

Q2. Explain when a dictionary is a clearer choice than a list.

Official Teacher Solution
Q1. Iteration reads each current item, while structural changes can shift positions and make results harder to predict.
Q2. A dictionary is clearer when values are retrieved by meaningful keys rather than position.

All questions and solutions are synthetic public test content.
